items.basis: Now inside its rumored Jul 17 GA window after a ground-up rebuild; leaked 2M context + Deep Think, but still no model card, pricing or API listing.
Polymarket: ~90% by Dec 31, 75% by Sep 30, only ~40% by then earlier. GPT-5.6 already shipped; next numbered flagship expected H2 2026.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; unannounced, no dated market.
xAI (now SpaceXAI) shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; a Grok 5 foundation is floated but undated.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is pending, with a reported Jul 24 developer deadline.
